location.courseTitle: Ready for Life 12: Independent Adult Living Capstone

instructions: Complete the task or its stated simulation alternative. Do not submit photos, recordings, addresses, account details, or private household information.
Learner completion never certifies a guardian-authority task; those tasks remain pending until a guardian attests.

learnerTasks.directions: Before assembling, decide who, if anyone, should ever see this plan.
learnerTasks.prompt: Before you finalize anything, who — if anyone — do you want to be able to see this plan, and why that choice?

learnerTasks.directions: Assemble the week's artifacts into one plan.
learnerTasks.prompt: My assembled plan includes the support-network map, early-ask scripts, threshold sorting, and urgent-help script.

learnerTasks.directions: Assemble the week's artifacts into one plan.
learnerTasks.prompt: My assembled plan includes the contingency branch from the previous lesson.

learnerTasks.directions: Record your chosen privacy level and a review date.
learnerTasks.prompt: State your chosen privacy level for this plan (for example, 'private, mine only' or 'shared with one specific trusted adult, by role'), and set a specific date to review and update it. Explain why that review date makes sense.

learnerTasks.directions: Reflect on what would make you actually use it.
learnerTasks.prompt: Honestly, what would make you actually open and update this plan on your chosen review date instead of forgetting about it?

learnerSuccessCriteria: Provide evidence that meets the stated Assembly completeness criterion.
Provide evidence that meets the stated Currency and privacy criterion.
accommodations: Access supports may change format, pacing, quantity, setting, or response mode without changing the assessed objective.
